Trigger: Our zone caps create visible price advantage in capped zones
Impact: Erodes demand recovery from caps; 30-50% of elasticity-driven demand recaptured by competitor
Mitigation: Zone caps less visible than platform-wide. Focus on completion/satisfaction advantage, not price alone.

Trigger: Any surge pricing at all drives price-sensitive riders to alternatives
Impact: 8-12% of rare/occasional riders lost to zero-surge; frequent riders retained via loyalty
Mitigation: Loyalty protection for high-value riders. Accept rare rider attrition (LTV/CAC < 1.0 anyway).

Trigger: Surge caps reduce driver earnings >15% on peak trips
Impact: 10-20% driver shortfall during peak hours; completion rates drop 3-5pp
Mitigation: Zone caps preserve driver earnings on commercial/transit (highest volume). Offer driver bonus from retained rider revenue.
